about: The only Criminal Lawyer in Top 100 Super Lawyers in Texas 2019-24 consecutively. The only DWI lawyer to make Top 100 in Houston or Texas since 2017. Triple Board Certified. Recognized throughout Texas as one of the top criminal and DWI defense attorneys in the Houston area, Mark R. Thiessen prides himself on representing his clients aggressively in court and with caring outside the courtroom. With The Thiessen Law Firm, Mr. Thiessen specializes in criminal defense and DWI defense. Mr. Thiessen has won trials from Class B Misdemeanors to First Degree Felonies. While he handles all types of criminal cases, he maintains an emphasis in intoxicated related accidents because of his scientific knowledge and background.

Mr. Thiessen is Board Certified in (1) Criminal Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization; (2) DUI Defense Law by the National College of DUI Defense through the American Bar Association; and (3) DUI Law by DUI Defense Lawyers Association. Mr. Thiessen has been honored with the top AV Preeminent* rating by the Martindale-Hubbell peer-review process and received a 10/10 “Superb” rating by Avvo. The American Institute of DUI/DWI Attorneys named him as one of the 10 best attorneys for the state of Texas.

A competitor in sports and martial arts during his days off, Mr. Thiessen brings that competitive spirit to the courtroom as well. Mr. Thiessen is regular competitor as a Black Belt in Brazilian Jiu Jitsu. At the same time, representing clients against DWI charges can require the skills of a scientist, and so Mr. Thiessen also brings a working knowledge of the chemistry and anatomy of blood alcohol concentration tests. Mr. Thiessen has also achieved the designation as an ACS/CHAL Lawyer- Scientist by the American Chemical Society, the highest scientific rank in the nation that a lawyer can achieve.

A native of Houston, Mr. Thiessen maintains deep ties to the community. A graduate of The Kinkaid School, Texas Christian University and South Texas College of Law, Mr. Thiessen practiced civil law for three years before becoming a criminal defense trial attorney. He is on the board of directors and current co-chair of the DWI Committee for the Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association and the 50th President and on the board of directors for the Harris County Criminal Lawyers Association. Texas Monthly/Thompson Reuters has named Mr. Thiessen as a Super Lawyer since 2013, then in the Top 100 Super Lawyers in Houston for 2017-24. From 2019-24, Mr. Thiessen was the only DWI attorney to be named to the Top 100 Super Lawyers in Texas. In 2020, Mr. Thiessen was the only criminal lawyer included in the Top 100 Super Lawyers in all of Texas.

Mr. Thiessen maintains a busy schedule of national speaking engagements for educational purposes and professional development, and has been frequently published in professional publications for criminal defense attorneys.
In 2020, Mr. Thiessen opened an office in Aspen, Colorado for criminal defense. Since that time he has already tried and won misdemeanor and felony trials all over Colorado.

In 2024, Mr. Thiessen opened the personal injury branch of the Thiessen Law firm with partner Michael Pita. The two are now chomping at the bit to try cases for the injured and take down big insurance companies.
Where ever it is, whatever it is, Mr. Thiessen is your trial lawyer and not scared to fight the biggest cases against the toughest opponents. You have a giant, we will fight it.
